'''''Scorzonera laciniata''''', also known as '''cutleaf vipergrass''', is a species of herb in the family [[Asteraceae]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Podospermum laciniatum (L.) DC. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/5107640|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=''Podospermum laciniatum'' (Divided-leaved Viper's Grass) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/ASTR/Podospermum_laciniatum.php |access-date=2022-03-07 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
